body.segment: This article reports on an adaptation and validation study of SRCvoc (self-regulating capacity in vocabulary learning scale; Tseng et al. 2006) in a Japanese EFL setting.
The piloting phase revealed that factor structures were different from those in the original study.

The main study, including a self-reported measure of procrastination to explore the convergent evidence of the construct validity, suggests that the scale can be a valid measure of self-regulation capacity in vocabulary learning in a Japanese EFL environment.
These findings provide implications for future studies that utilize the same type of research paradigm.
